summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the 7 WebView enhancements in Reelo Watch Screen: Open in Browser sheet with installed browser detection, Brave recommendation card/popup, guided Secure DNS (dns.google) with LinkProperties detection, Stay on Original Site auto-return with domain whitelisting and 5s allow snackbar, Ad overlay cleaner with safe video/controls whitelist, background popup handling for popup-gated players, and real HTML5 video resume playback via ReeloBridge WebMessageListener with DataStore & Supabase sync.
